$comment: Canonical default frequency bands — the single source of truth, mirroring iOS SpectrumScanner/Models/Models.swift `Band.defaultBands`. Frequencies in Hz. Only UHF is enabled by default (where most wireless-mic activity lives). Keep in sync: config.yaml.example, scanner config.go DefaultConfig, the calibrate defaults, the README band table, and frontend src/constants.js DEFAULT_BANDS (used by the band editor's Reset to defaults). See docs/remote-band-editing.md.

bands.name: VHF
bands.description: VHF high — ATSC Ch 7-13; some wireless mics + IEMs.

bands.name: UHF
bands.description: UHF mic band (post-incentive-auction); channel overlay to Ch 51 (698 MHz).

bands.name: 900 MHz ISM
bands.description: 900 MHz ISM — Shure G-band and similar unlicensed mic gear.

bands.name: CBRS
bands.description: CBRS 3.5 GHz — private LTE / 5G for stadium and venue networks.

bands.name: WiFi 5
bands.description: WiFi 5 — UNII-1 through UNII-4; a long sweep on Pluto, so off by default.
